front.title: State Synchronization Procedures between Stateful Path Computation Elements (PCEs)

abstract.t:
The Path Computation Element (PCE) Communication Protocol (PCEP) provides mechanisms for PCEs to perform path computation in response to a Path Computation Client (PCC) request. The stateful PCE extensions allow a PCE to maintain and control the state of Label Switched Paths (LSPs) using PCEP, independent of the path setup type used.
A PCC can synchronize LSP state information to a stateful PCE, and can have PCEP sessions toward multiple PCEs. In some deployments, synchronizing LSP state directly between the stateful PCEs brings additional resiliency, for instance when a PCC-PCE session fails, and allows a single PCE to compute paths for a set of LSPs that are dependent on each other even when those LSPs are delegated to different PCEs.
This document describes procedures for synchronizing LSP state between stateful PCEs across various deployment scenarios and for preventing computation loops. It is published as Experimental to gather implementation and deployment experience.
